prerequisites: To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or to be enrolled in all subjects from years prior to the one in which this subject is located.

learning_outcomes.text: To know the most relevant regulations related to Industrial Safety and Hygiene
To understand the concepts of Industrial Safety and Hygiene
To know the general action techniques of Industrial Safety

learning_outcomes.text: To know the main types of pollutants, their effects, and associated action measures

learning_outcomes.text: To deepen knowledge of aspects related to recommended working conditions

syllabus_topics: TEMA 1.- Introduction to Work Safety and Hygiene
1.4.- Incidence of risk factors on health
2.3.- Work Safety and Hygiene in Spanish legislation
5.1.- Advantages, requirements, and characteristics of standards
9.3.- Theoretical hygiene and environmental limit values
TEMA 12.- Hygienic risks in the chemical industry
15.2.- Consequences of psychosocial factors on health
teaching_methods: Lectures (Oral and direct exposition, by the professor, of the fundamental knowledge corresponding to the topics of the subject.)
Problem-solving (The professor presents students with a series of problems for them to work on and solve in class in small groups.)
assessment_rules: Regarding the July exam (2nd call), the grade obtained by the student in the continuous assessment controls and presentations/expositions carried out during the teaching period will be maintained. This means that the student will only take the multiple-choice test for that exam. When the School exempts a student from the continuous assessment process, their grade will be 100% of the mark obtained in the aforementioned multiple-choice test. Ethical behavior is expected. In case of detecting unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized use of electronic devices, for example), it will be considered that the student does not meet the necessary requirements to pass the subject.
